format.description: File format version, `trayful/2`. Projects in `trayful/1` still open; `trayful migrate` rewrites them.

version.description: Your own version label for the prototype, e.g. `0.3`.

units.description: Unit for all sizes and positions. Only `mm` for now.

assets.description: Path to the assets file. Default `assets.yaml`, when the project has one.

libraries.description: Library files to load, as paths or glob patterns relative to the project folder.

setups.description: Setup files, as paths or globs. Default `["setups/*.yaml"]`.

setup.description: Setup a new table starts from, by file name without `.yaml` (e.g. `2-player`). Default: everything laid out in rows.

Manifest.title: Trayful project manifest
Manifest.description: The `trayful.yaml` file at the root of a project folder.
